notes.title: Patch V1.1 - A
notes.content:
+Additions+
Four new clothing options added to the customization menu.
New game plus now carries over any saved information about the player.

+Mobile Additions+
Implemented eight directional movement using touch controls.
Slightly increased speed of the characters movement.

+Changed Features+
Added a new report icon to backpack items if item hasn't stored properly.
Changed icons on the customization menu to have a white outline to detail what is selected.

+Bug Fixes+
Fixed an issue with purchasing the fishing rod from fishing shop.
Fixed an issue not being able to close the fishing shop upon purchasing the fishing rod.
Fixed an issue with purchasing upgrades from blacksmith shop.
Fixed an issue not being able to close dialog after purchasing an item from blacksmith shop.
Fixed an issue to not being able to sell produce from animals.
Fixed an issue selling crops and other items to the collection box would not fulfill quest system.
Fixed an issue with not being able to obtain fruit from trees.
Fixed an issue that could cause items in hotspot to not render properly.
Fixed collision issues that occurred during the players home.
Fixed an issue with being able to accidentally switch clothing whilst confirming customization.

+NOTE+
I would recommend that you start again, just use the new game function and overwrite your previous save this will ask you to transfer over any money obtained to the newer save. 
Sell all animals and crops before doing so as this will not be carried over

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure - A New Life Update 1.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25953962/0392df0ed2e1a0a522857a43d936cb238275a221.png
Hi, It's Brett again with another update for Farm Life. I've spent the last two weeks trying to flush out majority of the bugs that appear on our trello board and bring back the features that made Farm Life a unique experience compared to other farm simulation games available on steam.

So, whats new you say?

Well, mhmmm... cough, cough... choke. Wish come true for some of you there.

New Platforms

    Windows 32bit support has been added.
    Linux 32bit support has been added.
    Linux 64bit support has been added.
    Mac 64bit support has been added.


Full Controller Support

    Controller will now be able to access the mouse cursor to navigate menus such as the backpack, settings and quest menu.
    Added additional button configurations to the controller to allow instant access to backpack, settings and quest menu.
    Controls: Left Stick - Move, A Button - Equip Tool, RT - Use Tool, RB - Swap Tool Right, LB - Swap Tool Left, Y Button - Quest Menu, Start Button - Settings Menu, Back Button - Inventory.
    Menu Controls: Left Stick - Move Cursor, A Button - Accept/Confirm/Equip, B Button - Decline/Cancel.


New Tools

    Scythe - This tool is great for cutting overgrown grass and crops from your farm.
    Hammer - This tool is used to smash rocks that have stumbed upon your farm.
    Axe - This tool can be used in the woods area to chop down trees.


New Resouces

    Lumber - Gathered from chopping trees, not much use as of yet but can be sold for £1.
    Thatch - Gathered from cutting overgrown grass and crops, not much use as of yet but can be sold for £1.
    Stone - Gathered from smashing rocks, not much use as of yet but can be sold for £1.
    Topaz Ore - Gathered from the mine below a certain floor level, topaz can be sold for £30.
    Ruby Ore - Gathered from the mine below a certain floor level, rubycan be sold for £40.
    Rhodonite Ore - Gathered from the mine below a certain floor level, rhodonite can be sold for £50.


New Upgrades

    Hoe Upgrade - Now available to purchase from the blacksmith.
    PickAxe Upgrade - Now available to purchase from the blacksmith.
    Watering Can Upgrade - Now available to purchase from the blacksmith.
    BackPack Upgrade - Now available to purchase from the farmer.


New Furniture

    Chest - You can now store up to eight items within the chest. The chest can be accessed in the players home.


New Quest Book

    Quests - will be given at the start of each day, you may only receive certain quests depending on the season, time and progress. Each quest will have a goal and some rewards upon completing them.
    Rerolling Quests - you can reroll (wipe) quests at any time if you're unable to complete them.


New Customization

    Hair - Three new hair types are now available upon starting the game, these are for the viking players.


Bug Fixes and General Improvements

    You can now purchase multiple stacks of seeds. Though you must completely fill one stack before another is made.
    Other improvements but have forgotten at this point what they are, maybe you can enlighten me?
    Several bug fixes that have been filed on trello by @longyoc (Many Thanks!)


Known Bugs: If you cannot control the cursor please use the leave default key (L) and press (J) to rejoin. Controller: DPAD DOWN + Start Button to leave and Start Button to rejoin.

I'm now working on putting two player co-op back into the game reintroducing the online.

Stay Farming! :flfemale::flmale::flmayor:

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure - Back to Update 1.0
notes.content:
Hi All,

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25953962/a402bb9e50ec00d6d38637bee267046f9351a713.png

It's been a long time since I last updated Farm Life: Natures Adventure due to certain commitments I had made in terms of full time employment, studying for college and spending time with my husband.

I have taken a back step on all my commitments and decided the past month to really work on Farm Life: Natures Adventure to be able to bring a game that I would have liked it to have been from the start. I have taken a look at all the community posts on here... I hear you loud and clear.

I have tried to keep it to it's roots and I started with just adjusting some of the pre-existing features. You'll probably notice not much has changed in terms of the actual game but I hope you can enjoy the newer functions and features I have brought in since the last update made.

Since updating the game, everything is still a little broken and some features are currently disabled (couch coop and online functionality) until I can get the core mechanics back in to the game. I would personally advise all players to clear their in game data by using the clear option on the home screen.

I have decided to create a trello board on some of the progress I will be making over the coming months - https://trello.com/b/nQhhFEHS/farm-life-natures-adventure

Kind Regards,
Brett

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure - 1.2.3C
notes.content:
New Additions

NPC Mod Support
14 New Steam Achievements - If you've completed these tasks already, load your saved game as this will unlock them for you.

Who are you and who is that - Unlock this achievement by hosting your own online server or joining a private server, MMO server does not count towards this achievement.
All four seasons shall pass - Unlock this achievement by playing through an entire year within the game eventually witnessing all four seasons (Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter).
Starter Farmer - Unlock this achievement by playing for a time period of one hour in one saved game session.
True  Farmer - Unlock this achievement by playing for a time period of three hours in one saved game session.
Master  Farmer - Unlock this achievement by playing for a time period of five hours in one saved game session.
Mayors are judged by results - Unlock this achievement by completing all the mayors requests during the event hosted in Winter. There are four challenges that the mayor would like you to complete to gain his position. Wealth, Loyalty, History and Love you must complete at least three challenges to become mayor.
Romance set in stone - Unlock this achievement by getting married to one of the candidates and celebrate your wedding at home.
One step at a time - Unlock this achievement by having or adopting a child in one saved game session.
Country roads take me gnome - Unlock this achievement by using the service of the gnomes, their home can be found in the woods.
Diamonds are a farmers best friend - Unlock this achievement by mining and gathering fifty diamonds. 
Diamond in the rough - Unlock this achievement by mining and gathering one diamond.
Stop the hands of time - Unlock this achievement by playing one real life time event in-game. Halloween, Easter and Christmas are currently the only real life events.
Cheat activated - Unlock this achievement by activating a cheat code.



Changes

Online join animation now changes colour depending on servers available. Black(None), Red(Low), Yellow(Normal) and Green(High)


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with speaking to NPCs would cause the player interaction to lock up in certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue with being able to access buildings during the period of 12AM instead of 12PM.
Fixed an issue with still being able to connect online to other players whilst using cheats.
Fixed an issue with online name showing steam name during first initialization. Only your in-game player name should be revealed whilst playing online.

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure - 1.2.3B
notes.content:
Online Multiplayer
Many of you know that when I first added multiplayer it was very lacking in depth therefore I decided to go back to the start and try again.

MMO - Massive Multiplayer Online Server
Massive Multiplayer is asynchronous meaning that you are all connected but you are all in your own instances. You can see each other but they can't interact with your town.

World icon will prompt the player of disconnecting from the main server.
Speech icon will display a text box directly in the centre of the screen, here you can type to all players within the private server.


Host - Private Online Server
Hosting a private server connects you to one of our authenticated servers, once connected you will be able to see a online status bar at the bottom left of your screen.

World icon will prompt the player of disconnecting from the main server.
Speech icon will display a text box directly in the centre of the screen, here you can type to all players within the private server.
Invite icon will display only if you are hosting the server, pressing the icon will prompt the player of Private Server ID (PSID) code. You must send the following code to your friends, the code will be copied to your clipboard.


Join - Private Online Server
Joining a private server connects you to your friends authenticated server, when pressed the player will be prompted to enter a Private Server ID (PSID) code.

World icon will prompt the player of disconnecting from the main server.
Speech icon will display a text box directly in the centre of the screen, here you can type to all players within the private server.


Note: All server data is encrypted whilst sending over the network. Whilst this information is secure we ask you to follow these rules.
1. Never include your full name, address, phone number or any other personal information.
2. Offensive player names or steam names will be flagged and may lead to removal of access to the online servers.
3. Stay safe and play, enjoy the game together.


New Additions

Main menu button has been added to the setting cog wheel. NOTE: Please, make sure you have saved your progress before exiting as any unsaved progress will be lost.
Exit game button to the start menu for players to exit out the game client.
Debug files to store additional player data.
Debug files now has a size limit and will overwrite previous data once reached.
Green is now an starting colour option for player clothing.
Extra Keyboard keys (Numpad Keys and : ? ! £) whilst inputting text when naming player, farm, town, pet and online chat.
Windows to the players house and barn to reflect time of day.


Changes

Changed animation for seeds that regrow without being replanted. (Potato seeds, tomato seeds and eggplant seeds)
Changed regrowth seeds to no longer need to be watered.
Decreased the rate of regrowth seeds for Potato Seeds, Tomato Seeds and Eggplant Seeds.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with night fall calling removed functions.
Fixed an issue with mining not locating character position.
Fixed an issue with the HUD not syncing correctly.
Fixed an issue with black smith upgrading tools not working.
Fixed an issue with black smith not allowing purchases for farming tools.
Fixed an issue with black smith shop icon not directly above character model.
Fixed an issue with money HUD not loading properly when loading from another version.
Fixed an issue with using some keyboard keys whilst naming your character.
Fixed an issue with being limited to certain characters whilst entering cheats.
Fixed an issue with player house collision detection.

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure - 1.2.3A
notes.content:
Patch V1.2.3A

Seasonal New Additions
Santa Claus is coming to town during the period of 20/12/2016 - 25/12/2016.

Santa Claus will now visit your home on the 25th of December through the fireplace.
Christmas tree, you can choose if you want to celebrate christmas or not.
Festive bed cover is now unlockable through the event of christmas.
Santa's outfit unlockable through the event of christmas.
Gnomes now wear a special outfit for christmas when hired.

http://blockheadgames.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1.png

Other New Additions

Thunder and lightning will now produce heavy rain causing poor visibility.
Calendar switch, you can now have a look at all the special events happening throughout the year.
Fireplace to the home to give it a warmer feeling and for people to come down it.
Event area will now be decorated by the mayor when an event is taking place.
Four new steam achievements for you hardcore players to earn.
http://blockheadgames.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Clothing-Change.png http://blockheadgames.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/HouseUP.png http://blockheadgames.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Speed-Swimming.png http://blockheadgames.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/ToolUP.png


Changes

Changed animation for heavy rain, rain and snow.
Changed animation for calendar seasons.
Changed animation for pointing arrow during tutorial.
Changed weather affecting all outside areas, the beach was previously restricted to not having weather but now that has changed!
Changed the weather layer to not follow the players HUD, now weather feels more natural.
Changed mayor actions, players can no longer change benches to christmas trees.
Changed swimming text to include more information for the player.
Changed the objective in swimming to be more tailored to the newest achievement.
Changed swimming to skip the next day events upon completion.
Changed swimming player animation.
Changed horse racing to skip the next day events upon completion.
Changed horse racing event to show racers and horses before starting event.
Changed player house animation.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with tutorial not continuing properly if using keyboard or mouse controls.
Fixed an issue with tool tip text still appearing whilst equipping seeds.
Fixed an issue with trees not appearing over other trees properly.
Fixed an issue with weather sound effects not playing after sleeping.
Fixed an issue with children sleeping all the time and not being able to help with duties.
Fixed an issue with children not entering correctly when not having a married partner.
Fixed an issue with children bed not changing correctly.
Fixed an issue with summer beach day event not starting properly.
Fixed an issue with swimming event not ending.
Fixed an issue with horse racing day event not starting properly.
Fixed an issue with horse racing event not ending.
Fixed an issue with black underlay during conversations with mayor at horse racing and swimming events.
Fixed an issue with ground flowers not being affected by snow in rival farm.
Fixed an issue with movement halting whilst passing through to another part of the town.
Fixed an issue with movement getting stuck in one direction when speaking to NPCs.
Fixed an issue with interaction checking every object within the players view twice.


Modding

I’ve recently been taking a look at letting other players mod Farm Life: Natures Adventure. I wanted to build a modding system for players that want to add features into the game but wouldn’t have to learn a programming language. Therefore all our future modding will be run from a basic text file, we will have big news within the next couple of weeks.

Hope you have fun!

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure – 1.2.1
notes.content:
Update 1.2 Patch Notes

Halloween Content

Added masks for NPCs during Halloween.
Added more events during the period of October. **
Added secret locations and hidden entrances.
Changed birds to become crows during Halloween.
Changed the title screen during Halloween. **


** - Affected by date / time set on your OS.

New Additions

Added clothing shop - Violet is the new shopkeeper in town and she will sell you loads of new clothing from top to bottom. Violet is the first shopkeeper to be able to have discounts on certain products during the year, maybe waiting for a sale?
Added clothing for the player that can be purchased at clothing shop.
Added bees, you can now purchase bee hives from Tom the old farmer at the marketplace.
Bee hives will be located within the farm, right next door to the chicken coop. They will have their own patch ready for when you purchase the hives.
Bees produce honey everyday except in winter as they like to keep their honey to themselves during this season. "Get behind a fellow, black and yellow"
Added birds, birds will fly away from you when you're too close. They'll land on wooden fences, house tops and tree branchs. 
Added frame rate pacing due to frame rate dropping when no frames needed to be updated on the clients screen. This will improve majority of animations that didn't sync due to a frame rate spike.
Added honey to the inventory system, this can be located in the inventory through Animal Care > Animal Items > Farm Produce. This also splits the animal section into two animal produces Milk, Wool, Egg and Manure then other Honey.
Added floating icons above all shop keepers so you can identify the shop keeper upon entering.
Added option to change the alarm clock to midnight. So you can walk in the dark, see the night light up and visit shops during the early morning.
Added audio and more information to when there is an event taking place and trying to enter a building which is closed. 
Added rotatable character model on character customization menu.


Improvements

Changed in-game time from 6am to 9am when finishing the tutorial. This should allow you shop on the first day and enter majority of the buildings.
Changed in-game timer to be extended for a longer period. PC: from 12 to 15 minutes / Mobile: from 15 to 20 minutes.
Changed corn field within the marketplace area, so that the player no longer clips through the corn.
Changed old farmer to Tomwares which is now open from 8am till 4pm. Tom will sell all buildings for your farm.
Changed map to reflect the changes to the farm and other parts of the town.
Changed controller deadzone area. This will make it better for controlling the player if you're using an old controller.
Changed pickaxe effectiveness when mining ore from 1/2/5/10 to 1/3/5/10.

Fixed an issue that would cause Steam to not unlock achievements when all requirements are fulfilled.
Fixed an issue with co-op partner spawning at the first player location which would cause it to glitch backwards into another section.
Fixed an issue with Steam overlay not responding correctly due to frame rate issue - "Implementation of frame rate pacing"
Fixed an issue with all RNG functions to become more effective when dealing with smaller chance rate.
Fixed an issue with shops having a black overlay after purchasing an item.
Fixed an issue with glove equipment no longer working outside of the tutorial.
Fixed an issue with removing seeds from the HUD would cause the counter to freeze/lock.
Fixed an issue with fishing rod always causing the player to turn right upon casting.
Fixed an issue with price clipping issue with selling produce at the shop.
Fixed an issue with pickaxe tool not working correctly in certain instances.
Fixed an issue with two player milking and shearing animals would cause the second player to use first players animation.
Fixed an issue with love hearts from appearing whilst talking to shopkeepers.
Fixed an issue with saving the game with a controller connected, then loading and playing without a controller.
Fixed an issue with old functions that are no longer available.
Fixed an issue with NPC characters spawning outside during working hours, marriage or late at night.


Other Notes

Removed networking until further testing can be done with the newest systems in place.

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure Patch V1.1.1.00
notes.content:
Farm Life: Natures Adventure Patch V1.1.1.00

When we release a stable version of Farm Life: Natures Adventure. We try our best to fix majority of the issues before releasing the update but because the simulation gets bigger and takes more resources each time we add new features. Bugs are very common and everytime we test our game, we only test with certain elements of the simulation on and this can make us miss some of them.

Improvements
Fixed farming with mouse control constantly looping causing framerate drops.
Fixed interaction constantly checking if the player was near an object regardless of the simulation tick.
Fixed tooltip guide running the background without the player being within their inventory.
Fixed shops having a black overlay after purchasing an item.
Fixed player collision detection whilst holding certain tools and moving between different parts of the map.
Fixed opening times for stores that were open during midnight.
Fixed trees in the woods to be aligned correctly with all the other trees.
Changed closed stores to state they're closed upon entering.
Changed the flow of the water that runs between all sections on the map.
Changed signs in all areas to have the name of the location you are about to enter.

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure – Steam Update 1.1.0.00 stable release
notes.content:
New Additions

Added asynchronous online multiplayer.
Multiplayer as of now is asynchronous meaning that you are all connected to the same town but you are in your own instance. You can see them and they can see you but can't interact with your town.
We are testing synchronous multiplayer with private local hosted servers and limited to four players as this should feel more connected.
http://i0.wp.com/blockheadgames.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/online.png?resize=600%2C128
Added support for Steam trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons.
Added support for Steam overlay features to the main client. "Finally a Steam feature."
Added all NPCs to be able to attend events.
Added new NPC animations for stance and walking.
Added three new types of conversations to all NPCs.
Added NPC date nights. You can now go on dates with NPCs or just go for a walk depending on your relationship.
Added new tooltip to display name for each item within the players inventory when hovering over the item. "You see that fruit, what fruit?. The pixel red like an apple one."
Added new toggle tooltip option in inventory.
Added new furniture to the players house for online interaction. (Note: If loading a save from a previous version you will need to leave the house and re-enter for it to appear.)
Added control scheme for farming and mining using the mouse for player one only. You hover over the area within a square radius around the player. Left click to use tool and right click to use seeds.
Added another zero to our version because of online multiplayer. Our version number will be Major, Minor, Patch, Multiplayer - 1.1.0.00
Added new music for all seasons and title screen. Music composed by Kevin Macload, he is amazing. You should check his portfolio of music at http://www.incompetech.com
Added credits button to title screen.

Improvements

Improved options menu to show more information about button and align all buttons together.
Improved settings menu to show more information about button and align all buttons together. "Don't ask how you all should've known what they was?"
Fixed some collision detection with NPC animations. "Big pixels equal big collisions? Nope..."
Fixed duplication within inventory that could cause players food inventory to become out of sync.
Fixed NPC issues with loading from another section. This could lead the NPCs to forget everything. "Hey, you are the new farm keeper. Hey, you are the new farm keeper. Hey, you are the new farm keeper."
Fixed Horce Racing that would be unplayable after first race and improved the load time of race, riders and horses.
Fixed remappable controls generating in the background whilst not on the control menu.
Fixed player being able to interact with objects not assigned to the tutorial.
Fixed alt-tabbing out of game window could cause game window to swap to full-screen borderless.
Fixed text issue which could cause text to move after being visable to the players HUD.
Fixed alignment issues with numbers on the calendar within players house.
Changed part-time job to include two players. You will now receive double the money.
Changed animations for some icons within the inventory. "Back is now... Back!"
Changed font and made sure it is pre-loaded before the game starts.

Removal

F12 will no longer save local screenshots to desktop. This has been replaced by Steam overlay and will now be sharable to the community hub.
Removed some assets and programming. "Less space. I'll take it"
Removed old existing font from game directory.

notes.title: Hello Everyone
notes.content:
Since our last patch we’ve made great progress on a lot of features ready for the release of Steam Update 1.0.2

We would like to say this is a feature we have always wanted to announce for Farm Life: Natures Adventure from the beginning of development and now its starting to come together perfectly.

Steam has been a great help in getting exposure to Farm Life: Natures Adventure and to well BlockheadGames in general… When we put our game on Steam greenlight, the feedback was great and whilst we learned on how to promote, market and distribute our game during that phase, we will do better next time around. We got through greenlight and released our game on Steam. We knew that Steam wouldn’t just be a platform for us to distribute our game on but a platform we could grow on and learn more about developing with the community that play our games.

Therefore, we have now added the full Steam API into Farm Life: Natures Adventure so you won’t need to save your pictures locally. Now, you can upload them to the community hub and show everyone else your town, townsfolk and your progress. This will also add Achievements that were disabled at launch.

The biggest announcement that we have for you today is…

Online Multiplayer

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25953962/0291982eeb1befdddc87d0d0a0e2529af8a1141a.png

We have integrated online multiplayer into Farm Life: Natures Adventure we are still working on this feature and we can’t wait for you all to join us. We are publishing this update on the 19/09/2016.

Like to hear more about the mobile version or in more detail about multiplayer then visit our blog - BlockheadGames Blog

Thank you everyone for playing the game and we hope to see you soon!

Brett

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
New Additions

Added remappable keyboard controls limited to alphabet and arrow keys.
Added remappable default (I) key to open / close inventoy without clicking the backpack.
Added support for two player with two controllers.
*If you would like to play with two controllers, you will need to disconnect player one by pressing default (L) key.
Added swappable tools from inventory without having to unequip your previous tool.
Added swappable seeds from inventory without having to unequip your previous seeds.
Added seasonal calender animation to the players home.
Added sign to clothing shop to state that it is currently unavailable.
Added version number to start menu and included new font within the game directory.


Improvements

Changed the start menu player, farm, town and pet name fields to contain more dialog about the player.
Changed the starting tutorial to include most of the tools and giving more information to the player. (You're no longer too young to be able to do anything...)
*You will also gain an extra £1000 for completing the tutorial. The rest of the tutorial is on our list of things we would like to improve. 
Changed safe lock off shop feature to be more quicker. (When purchasing an item at the shops, the speech from the shop keeper will no longer appear after each purchase).
Fixed mining ladder causing the player being unable to move and always showing the ladder upon enter.
Fixed settings issue that could cause the game to lock the players state making the following disabled (Inventory, settings and all interaction.)
Fixed choice speech dialog that could cause the game to lock the players state making the following disabled (Inventory, settings and all interaction.)
Fixed some NPC's spawning in their old homes even when they're married and also living at the players home.
Fixed starting player colour not changing after completing the tutorial.
Fixed collision detection on the player within certain locations.
Fixed player two being able to spawn during start menu and during the tutorial.
Fixed player two being able to walk during the train journey.
Fixed female player head animations whilst carrying watering can.
Fixed enter key that could cause start menu player, farm, town and pet name fields longer than intended.


Removal

Removed F12 key from bringing up the debug menu and replaced with screenshot to be saved locally.

notes.title: Farm Life: Natures Adventure Launch
notes.content:
Farm Life: Natures Adventure launch is just about to happen. We can't wait for everyone to finally play it. The game will be priced at $2.99 - US  £1.99 - UK  €2.99 - EU and at your currency equivalent it will also launch with a discount of 33% for the first week. 

We are working on loads of new features for the upcoming weeks that follow the launch some of the features are 

Trading Cards.
Online Festivals. 
Coop Minigames. (Horse Racing and Swimming) 
Full Translation. 
Modding Support. (NPCs, Houses, Upgrades etc.) 
More graphical options including different resolutions. 
Completely changing majority of the tutorials. 
Mac and Linux Support. (Both versions need fully testing) 
Graphics. (Our last and biggest change that will be made)


We are looking for people that have a Mac or Linux operating system, so we can check these versions before launching them on steam. 

Thank you to everyone that voted for us during steam greenlight and we have hope you enjoy the game.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25953962/0392df0ed2e1a0a522857a43d936cb238275a221.png
